welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.text: We will show the app through the eyes of a student, a parent and a teacher. Each step opens a real screen with demo school data and highlights a feature — you can try it. Use Next and Back or the ← → keys; the cross closes the tour and leaves you in the app.

onboarding.title: Meeting the AI tutor
onboarding.text: A student's first sign-in is a conversation with the AI (GigaChat), not a form. The tutor asks about interests, goals and free time, builds a profile and suggests school clubs: join now or «try later». This is Dasha — she has not met the tutor yet.

studentStats.title: Streak and crystals
studentStats.text: Next is Alexey, who already studies here. The streak grows while the student attends lessons or submits work at least every other day. Crystals: 50 per attended lesson and 20 per assignment done above 75%.

studentWeek.title: Attendance this week
studentWeek.text: The arc of weekdays: green — attended, red — missed, blue — today, grey — no lessons.

studentSchedule.title: Schedule
studentSchedule.text: Lessons of the selected day: club, group and time. Arrows change the day, the icon on the left opens the month calendar, the bell opens notifications.

studentTutor.title: AI tutor
studentTutor.text: A GigaChat chat that knows the student's schedule, assignments and progress: it explains a topic, suggests where to start and leads to the solution without doing the work. Try asking a question. Chats are kept in the history.

studentRecommendations.title: Today's recommendations
studentRecommendations.text: How many open assignments each club has — by the nearest deadline.

studentMap.title: Assignment map
studentMap.text: Each planet is one of the student's clubs: the number is points earned, the arrow is the nearest deadline. Tapping opens the assignment or the club's course. Planets with a lock are clubs the student has not chosen yet.

studentCourse.title: Course
studentCourse.text: A teacher's course consists of modules and blocks: text, video, quiz, homework. You can see which blocks are done and which are required.

studentAssignment.title: Submitting work
studentAssignment.text: The student writes an answer and attaches a photo of the solution or a document. The teacher reviews it, and the comment appears on this screen.

studentProfile.title: Progress
studentProfile.text: Homework results: correct, incorrect, upcoming. Above is this week's attendance, below — assignments in each club.

studentTrajectory.title: AI trajectory
studentTrajectory.text: From lessons and assignments the AI builds the student's trajectory: strengths, areas to grow and next steps. Expand the card with the button on the right.

studentSettings.title: Settings
studentSettings.text: Theme (as in MAX, light or dark), role switching, support chat and signing out. Parents and teachers have similar settings.

parentChildren.title: Children
parentChildren.text: Now it is Olga, the mother. Her children are the hearts at the top: swipe them, and the home screen shows the schedule and assignments of the selected child. «+» at the end of the row links another child.

parentSchedule.title: Child's schedule
parentSchedule.text: The child's lessons by day: club, teacher and time. «Add a club» leads to the school's clubs.

parentHomework.title: Completed assignments
parentHomework.text: How many assignments the child completed in a day, 7 or 30 days in each club; the number with an asterisk is how many are recommended.

parentWallet.title: Wallet
parentWallet.text: The parent's balance and a top-up in a couple of taps. Top-up is in demo mode for now: no money is charged.

parentClubs.title: Child's clubs
parentClubs.text: The selected child's clubs: schedule, price, paid-until date and the next payment, the teacher's card.

parentPayments.title: Payments
parentPayments.text: What is due for each club and the payment history. «Pay» opens the payment provider's page, and the payment goes to the teacher's wallet.

parentAnalytics.title: Child's progress
parentAnalytics.text: Assignments in each club: «More» shows each of the child's assignments. Above are this week's attendance and homework results.

parentTutor.title: AI tutor for parents
parentTutor.text: Tells how the child is doing: attendance, homework and where support is needed. The child can be changed in the header.

parentLink.title: Linking a child
parentLink.text: The parent creates an invitation link and sends it to the child in MAX — or enters the code from the child's profile.

parentCatalog.title: School clubs
parentCatalog.text: A catalogue of clubs with schedule and price: first the ones the child does not attend yet.

teacherHome.title: Teacher's home
teacherHome.text: Now it is Maria, the teacher. Her groups' schedule by day; the wallet balance is at the top.

teacherAssignments.title: Assignments
teacherAssignments.text: Open and closed assignments and how many students submitted each.

teacherActions.title: Assign homework and mark attendance
teacherActions.text: The teacher's two main actions are always at hand.

teacherAssign.title: Assign homework
teacherAssign.text: Three steps: to whom (group and students), what (one assignment or a whole course) and the material — your own files or a description. The AI builder then assembles the material, and the student sees it in the course.

teacherBuilder.title: AI course builder
teacherBuilder.text: Describe a topic in your own words or upload materials (pdf, docx, txt, md) — the AI writes a summary, breaks it into knowledge atoms and assembles a course with lessons and practice.

teacherAttendance.title: Attendance
teacherAttendance.text: Pick a lesson and mark each student: present, absent, late or excused — or «Everyone came» in one tap.

teacherPerformance.title: Group progress
teacherPerformance.text: Attendance by club and homework by group for a day, 7 or 30 days or the whole course. From a group you can open each student.

teacherStudent.title: Student card
teacherStudent.text: The student's attendance, homework results and assignments by club.

teacherWallet.title: Teacher's wallet
teacherWallet.text: Balance and its change over a period, transactions, who owes how much for lessons, withdrawals.

teacherGroups.title: Groups
teacherGroups.text: The teacher's groups: number of students, attendance and the next lesson. Groups, students and schedules are managed here too.

teacherCourses.title: Courses
teacherCourses.text: Group courses and their publication status; a new course is created here too.

teacherDemand.title: Club demand
teacherDemand.text: Results of students meeting the AI tutor: how many joined, want to try later or skipped, AI relevance and «future» directions — ideas for new clubs.

finish.title: That's all!
finish.text: You have seen all three roles. The tour will close, and the app stays open — feel free to keep using it. To run the demo again, sign out in the settings.
